name: Pocket Kanojo ~Hakudaku Ningyou~
original_name: ポケット彼女 ～白濁人形～
source:
[url=/c131192]Hideki Minami[/url] has a one-sided crush on [url=/c6192]Chiaki Horie[/url], who attends the same school.

Hideki, who lacks communication skills to begin with, only has fun interacting with bishoujo figurines and bishoujo figurine enthusiasts on web forums. One day, he discovers a way to miniaturize humans and succeeds in making Chiaki figurine-sized. He has the heroine he admires live in his room and tortures her to the fullest...

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.masterup.net/paranoia/pocket.html]product page[/url]]
translation:
[url=/c131192]南秀树[/url]单恋着同校的[url=/c6192]堀江千秋[/url]。秀树本就不善交际，唯一的乐趣就是在网上论坛与美少女手办及同好互动。一天，他发现了将人类缩小的方法，并成功将千秋变成了手办大小。他让仰慕的女主角住在自己房间里，尽情地折磨她……

[大致译自[url=http://www.masterup.net/paranoia/pocket.html]产品页面[/url]]
